tagline: Leading timberland REIT with productive softwood timber growing regions across the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA is Rayonier's primary operational performance metric, reflecting cash generation capacity before interest, taxes, and non-recurring items. This metric captures profitability across the three key segments (Southern Timber, Pacific Northwest Timber, and Real Estate) and demonstrates relative business stability despite revenue fluctuations.

risks.title: Timber price fluctuations and market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Timber demand is directly tied to demand for pulp, paper, packaging, lumber, and other wood products. Southern timber sales are sensitive to pulp and sawlog markets, while the Pacific Northwest depends heavily on domestic lumber customers and exports to Asia-Pacific. Recent tariffs (10% duty on softwood lumber) and Canadian tariffs impact pricing.

risks.title: Leverage and capital structure
risks.score_rationale: Although the company maintains investment-grade credit ratings (BBB/Baa3), it relies on access to external financing for timberland acquisitions. Significant debt service obligations and interest costs ($26.3M in 2025) may constrain financial flexibility.

ai_positioning.summary: Rayonier has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its filed documents. Its core business focuses on forest management, timber sales, and real estate operations.
